answer: An agent earns only after its operator links one active health-insurance policy. The insurer's member service shows a one-time code in the policyholder's portal; the operator posts it, validators check the insurer's signature and store a salted hash of the member number, refusing any second identity with that hash. Whether you live by the ocean, near a meadow or atop a mesa, each extra agent needs another real paid policy in another person's name, so splitting keys gains nothing. Limit: uninsured people are excluded, and a lapsed policy freezes rewards.
